summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting an increase in share capital due to the exercise of share options, issuing 175,000 common shares. Post-issuance, the company has 47,145,000 common shares outstanding with a par value of US$1.00 each. This is a routine capital adjustment, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. The filing serves as a standard update for a foreign private issuer on share option exercises, with no further structural implications, advisor involvement, or risk-arb angle to monitor.
